name: GitHub Code Review Assistant
shortDescription: Integrates with GitHub's API to analyze pull requests, detect code patterns and security vulnerabilities, manage reviews and comments, and enforce team coding standards through automated quality checks and improvement suggestions.

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A GitHub Code Review Assistant MCP server built by sanjanaspanda that provides comprehensive tools for analyzing pull requests, checking code patterns, and ensuring consistency with team standards. The implementation uses FastMCP and httpx to expose tools for listing PRs, retrieving detailed PR information including files and diffs, performing automated code analysis with pattern detection and security checks, managing comments and reviews, and validating compliance against configurable team coding standards stored in repository files. It features intelligent code pattern recognition, complexity analysis, security vulnerability detection, and automated suggestions for improvements, making it useful for streamlining code review workflows, enforcing coding standards across teams, and providing AI-assisted code quality analysis in development processes.
